Priya Narang: Heads-up — we have a 15m QBR with Meridian on Thursday. SVP GTM will attend. Need: single-slide exec asks, current onboarding blockers, renewal signal and named owners. Drive: https://tiny.redwood/meridian-qbr

Ben Hart: I can pull the 30d usage and weekly activation funnel. Will drop charts into slide 3 by EOD.

Sofia Ramos: Renewal status = yellow. Biggest risks: no analytics export, stalled SSO claim mapping, and seat activation plateau. Suggest ask: short-term usage credits + prioritized export access.

Theo Nguyen: I scheduled a quick engineering triage for the SSO mapping tomorrow 10:00. If fixed, routing test follows Fri morning.

Carmen Li: Ill run a focused enablement sprint (3 days) to drive seat activation — need approval for 6 SE-hours. Will craft a 1-page runbook.

Priya Narang: Draft exec asks in doc under slide 1: "Approve 4-week pilot extension with usage credits; prioritize analytics export; allocate SE hours for enablement." Everyone, please add a one-line ask by EOD.

Ben Hart: Added charts and a 30/60 retention projection table. Noting the assumption that caching is off.

Sofia Ramos: SSO ticket assigned to Meridian infra, ETA Thu EOD. Analytics export escalation raised to product.

calendar-bot: Reminder set: final deck review 2025-05-05 16:00.

Priya Narang: Action items (copying here):
- Carmen: enablement runbook + SE hours request (due Tue EOD)
- Ben: data slides and appendix (due Wed noon)
- Theo: SSO triage outcome (due Thu 11:00)
- Sofia: renewal score + mitigation wording (due Wed 5pm)
- Priya: finalize asks + dry-run script (due Thu morning)

Carmen Li: Will post the runbook by Tue and prep a 3-slide enablement appendix for the deck.

Ben Hart: I'll be on the dry run.

Priya Narang: Dry-run scheduled Thu 08:30 (12 min). Please keep remarks to 90s each. Thanks.
